language.script_notes: The Cyrillic used for Kyrgyz looks like Russian but adds letters not found in Russian, notably ң, ө and ү. Russian remains widely used alongside it. The internet domain is .kg.

road_furniture.bollard_color: Simple white bollards with a diagonal black stripe near the top.
road_furniture.km_marker_style: Kilometre markers with a red-and-white triangle pattern are unique to this country. Concrete utility poles are often painted white at the bottom, and trees and poles are commonly seen together along roadsides.

architecture.roof_style: Yurts — round felt tents on a wooden lattice — dot the high summer pastures.
architecture.distinctive_building_types: Yurts on the high summer pastures (jailoo) used by semi-nomadic herders; a landscape of deep gorges, alpine lakes and rushing rivers rather than dense towns.

nature.vegetation: Alpine meadow and summer pasture (jailoo) on the high plateaus, spruce forest on mountain slopes, walnut forest in the south around Arslanbob, and dry steppe in the valleys.
nature.terrain: One of the most mountainous countries in the world — over 90% of the land is mountains of the Tian Shan range, with snow-capped peaks, deep valleys and high plateaus, and Lake Issyk-Kul, one of the largest alpine lakes on Earth.
nature.climate_signature: Coverage was captured in winter, so many trees are bare, the landscape looks drab and snow is visible across much of the country.

vehicles.plate_color: White plate with a red vertical stripe or rectangle carrying a yellow symbol on the left, with the national flag in a narrow band.
vehicles.plate_format: Modern plates use Latin letters rather than Cyrillic.

google_coverage.camera_generation: The Street View car is distinctive and is often seen surrounded by mountains, sometimes with snow.
google_coverage.coverage_notes: All of the country was captured during the winter months, so the imagery is bare and drab, with snow common.

confusion_set.shared_traits: Shared Tien Shan mountains near Almaty, Cyrillic signage with extra letters, and Soviet-era architecture
confusion_set.tiebreaker: Plates with a red stripe or rectangle carrying a yellow symbol and Latin letters, red-and-white triangle kilometre markers, and bollards with a diagonal black stripe near the top point here.

confusion_set.shared_traits: Shared Central Asian mountain and valley landscapes
confusion_set.tiebreaker: The distinctive red-and-white kilometre markers and plate design differ; compare plates and script directly.

confusion_set.shared_traits: Yurts, herding culture and open grassland
confusion_set.tiebreaker: Kyrgyz Cyrillic letters ң, ө and ү and the mountain terrain differ from Mongolian signage and plains.
